fsm_states_mac.name: IDLE
fsm_states_mac.description: Transceiver off or RX_ON; awaiting a frame to transmit or a received PPDU.

fsm_states_mac.name: CSMA_BACKOFF
fsm_states_mac.description: CSMA-CA: wait a random (2^BE - 1) backoff periods (aUnitBackoffPeriod = 20 symbols).

fsm_states_mac.name: CCA
fsm_states_mac.description: Clear Channel Assessment; if busy increment BE and retry up to macMaxCSMABackoffs.

fsm_states_mac.name: WAIT_ACK
fsm_states_mac.description: If Acknowledgment Request set, wait macAckWaitDuration for the ACK frame.

fsm_states_mac.name: RX
fsm_states_mac.description: Receive a PPDU; check FCS; deliver MSDU or process MAC command/beacon.

fsm_states_mac.name: RETRY
fsm_states_mac.description: On missing ACK retransmit up to macMaxFrameRetries (3).

fsm_states_association.name: SCAN
fsm_states_association.description: ED / active / passive / orphan scan to find a PAN / coordinator.

fsm_states_association.name: ASSOCIATE
fsm_states_association.description: Send Association request MAC command; receive a short address in the Association response.

fsm_states_association.name: JOINED
fsm_states_association.description: Associated; participates in the PAN (beacon-tracking if beacon-enabled).

fsm_states_association.name: ORPHAN
fsm_states_association.description: Loss of sync; orphan notification / orphan scan to relocate the coordinator.

fsm_states_nwk_join.name: NWK_DISCOVERY
fsm_states_nwk_join.description: Discover networks via MAC scans; select a parent (Coordinator or Router).

fsm_states_nwk_join.name: NWK_JOIN
fsm_states_nwk_join.description: Join through the parent; obtain a 16-bit network address; receive the network key from the Trust Center.

fsm_states_nwk_join.name: ROUTING
fsm_states_nwk_join.description: Maintain neighbor/routing tables; AODV route discovery (RREQ/RREP) on demand.
